contexts.text: The moment their conceit is taken away, they fall down into their Hell. This is not an appearance, but a fallacy...
They said that they had fallen down from a certain angelic Society... Therefore they fell down thence; not that they were cast down... but, being in falsity, they fell down of their own accord.
When... I fell down into thought about worldly things...
Falsity from evil... falls down towards lower things, like a heavy body in the world.
Falsity and evil are both heavy, and therefore they both fall down...
When... they fall down into their natural light... they fall into thick darkness...
They who are in falsities from evil fall down into Hell. AC 9333:end.
Thus, of their own accord, they fall down into Hell.
When the sphere of the Divine... falls down into the Societies below...
Under Star, see this reference. AE 535.
I have sometimes heard goods and truths which have fallen down from Heaven into Hell... turned into their opposites... AE 518:2.
Without such a Providence, they would fall to pieces every moment.
I saw some one who had fallen down from a certain heavenly Society.
On the fall of Spirits from the Heavens.
That to fall down or to fall from Heaven into the earth = to perish. Explained, Illustrated.
